classification_vocabulary.meaning: Implemented by native Rust or V8-backed isolate operations in the Nimbus runtime or nimbus/deno fork.
Implemented as JavaScript or TypeScript compatibility code that mirrors Node behavior while preserving the isolate permission boundary.
Emulates process, stream, or host-adjacent state inside the isolate without mutating host-global process state.
Exists only to execute and measure upstream Node fixtures; it is not a production application capability.
The runtime intentionally denies or routes the surface and records an actionable boundary diagnostic instead of granting host authority.
Not supported in the in-process V8 isolate profile; requires upstream, native, host-capable service, or microVM work before it can become a support claim.

entries.claimed_capability: Native Rust and V8-backed Node extension operations provide the low-level isolate implementation for Node builtins that are promoted into the V8-isolate-required surface.
entries.capability_limits: Native isolate support remains bounded by Nimbus runtime permission profiles and by the generated default-support posture; it is not a grant of ambient host process, filesystem, network, or native-addon authority.

entries.claimed_capability: JavaScript and TypeScript polyfills mirror Node-visible behavior for promoted APIs while delegating authority checks to Deno/Nimbus runtime permissions.
entries.capability_limits: A shimmed API may match Node semantics for measured fixtures without implying full Node CLI parity or access outside declared runtime roots.

entries.claimed_capability: Host-adjacent Node state is emulated inside each isolate so fixture-visible semantics can pass without mutating host-global process state.
entries.capability_limits: Emulation is per-isolate and capability-scoped; it must not expose host cwd mutation, process exit, OS signals, ambient subprocesses, or unbounded filesystem access.

entries.claimed_capability: Nimbus carries harness-only emulation so upstream Node fixtures can be executed, classified, and promoted with reproducible diagnostics.
entries.capability_limits: Harness helpers are evidence infrastructure and do not become public production Node APIs or application capabilities.

entries.claimed_capability: Production in-process application profiles return denial or service/microVM route diagnostics for host-heavy behavior instead of granting host authority.
entries.capability_limits: Diagnostic evidence is not positive in-process support; these surfaces require a service or microVM profile when the application genuinely needs host authority.

surfaces: upstream known issue or platform-specific fixture behavior
entries.claimed_capability: Unsupported entries remain visible as measured boundaries in the generated posture and lane classification catalogs.
entries.capability_limits: These entries are excluded from V8-isolate-required support claims until an owner lands fixture-backed native, shimmed, emulated, or service-routed behavior.
